names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 23 октября ст. ст., «Николай (Агафонников), протоиерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The line declines the name and gives it without the surname, as «Сщмчч. Николая ... пресвитеров».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Николая , Владимира , Александра , Николая , Емилиана и Созонта пресвитеров (1937).»

attestations.note: He is the first of the two men called Николай on the line, told from the second by surname and not by the line, which gives neither. The line calls the six of them пресвитеров together; the link behind his place says протоиерей, so his office says archpriest and his types keep the line's word. His name page carries no life and names a parish church dedicated to him, «Храм в честь священномученика Николая Подольского» at Podolsk in the Moscow diocese.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of the company line it names him in on 23 октября ст. ст. The calendar carries no life page for him and gives no day.
